article.story: Baylor (4-2) at Kansas (2-4), Oct. 24 at 1 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Baylor by 1.5. Against the spread: Baylor 4-2, Kansas 1-4. How to watch: TNT Key stats Baylor Offense Overall: 436.2 yards per game (39th in FBS) Passing: 286 yards per game (16th) Rushing: 150.2 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 30 points per game (65th) Baylor Defense Overall: 326.7 yards per game (40th in FBS) Passing: 240 yards per game (110th) Rushing: 86.7 yards per game (9th) Scoring: 14.7 points per game (9th) Kansas Offense Overall: 449.7 yards per game (29th in FBS) Passing: 242.5 yards per game (55th) Rushing: 207.2 yards per game (23rd) Scoring: 32 points per game (50th) Kansas Defense Overall: 348.7 yards per game (62nd in FBS) Passing: 174.3 yards per game (26th) Rushing: 174.3 yards per game (106th) Scoring: 24 points per game (74th) Baylor is 119th in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 75% of trips. Kansas' red zone defense ranks 38th at 78.3%. Team leaders Baylor Passing: D.J. Lagway, 1,116 yards, 8 TDs, 3 INTs, 50 completion percentage Rushing: Dawson Pendergrass, 328 yards on 89 carries, 1 TD Receiving: Gavin Freeman, 555 yards on 49 catches, 2 TDs Kansas Passing: Isaiah Marshall, 1,294 yards, 9 TDs, 5 INTs, 52.7 completion percentage Rushing: Dylan Edwards, 376 yards on 75 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: Nik McMillan, 400 yards on 23 catches, 4 TDs Last game Baylor lost 17-6 to TCU on Oct. 17. Lagway threw for 256 yards on 22-of-53 attempts (41.5%) with no touchdowns and one interception. Caden Knighten had 35 rushing yards on 10 carries. Freeman had seven receptions for 76 yards. Kansas fell to Kansas State 35-24 on Oct. 17. Marshall threw for 151 yards on 12-of-26 attempts (46.2%) with one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball 14 times for 117 yards. Edwards carried the ball 16 times for 57 yards and scored one touchdown, adding two receptions for 28 yards. McMillan recorded 55 yards on five catches with one touchdown. Next game Baylor plays at UCF on Oct. 30. Kansas plays at TCU on Oct. 31.
